clauses.clause: When this enchantment enters, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: cast: trigger [0] fires with you_giant (4/4, exactly power 4) on board and exactly one card is drawn; 'from your hand, the card enters during the opponent's turn': trigger and one draw again; tree = the compiler's B2b-etb-power-condition-draw parse. The false 'if' and the check as it resolves are not in the trace: packs D07_1 (3/3 only: no draw), D07_2 (power exactly 4: one draw), D07_5 (the 4/4 leaves in response: no draw).

cast: you_bear and you_giant gain +TRAMPLE; 'you cast a creature (Aegis Turtle)': the new creature enters with +TRAMPLE; no opposing creature gains it; creatures die with -TRAMPLE. Pack D07_6 shows it in combat (3 trample over a chump blocker, none for the opponent's attacker).

clauses.clause: Whenever a creature you control with power 4 or greater enters, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: the only creatures that enter in the trace have power 3 (you_spare) and 0 (Aegis Turtle), and the opponent's one has power 3: the trigger never fires and nothing shows a power-4 creature entering. Tree = the compiler's B2b-power-ge-enters-draw parse. Packs: D07_3 (3/3 draws nothing, my 4/4 draws one, the opponent's 5/5 draws nothing), D07_4 (each big creature draws its own card). Pack D07_7: two Knight tokens made at once (4/4 with Anthem of Champions) each trigger it, two draws.

survived: each occurrence -> once per event at 1/2
